items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Oscar Pettiford extensively but only mentions Lou Fromm in the interviewer's question as a drummer on a recording; the interviewee does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Lou Fromm.

ctx.x: Yes. I had -- that's an interesting story, when we get around to it. I had both of them.
Lou Fromm, drums. Killian, McGhee, Holland and Pettiford do not appear on camera, as white actors sat in their places. Okay, tell me the bass story.
Well, that -- well, first of all, about, "Jam Session," that was recorded all over the -- filmed all over the country, and then they sewed it together in Hollywood,
